player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukinnyi {player_id} mu mukino wa Connect Four.
Isimboli y'ikinwa: {symbol}.
Burende bwa mukino buriho {num_rows} amabaka na {num_cols} amakigo.
Abakinnyi bakina baramuka kubwira ikamba cyabo mu kigo (0 hadi {end_col}).
Uwa mbere ukina (ikamba cye) ine zikaba zinawe, zikabije cyangwa zikabije zikabije zikaba zikaba.
Muri igihe cyawe, shirikisha nambari y'ikigo mu mabano ya mirongo itegekezo ryawe.
Kwa mfano: '[col 4]' au '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: The game board is not visible to players.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umukinnyi {player_id}, Ikintu cyabaye si ngombwa cyane. Igihe kinabaye: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Umukinnyi {player_id}, Ikintu cyabaye si ngombwa. Kigo {col} kiri hasi.
invalid_move.already_full: Umukinnyi {player_id}, Ikintu cyabaye si ngombwa. Kigo {col} kimeze.

action.dropped_disk: Umukinnyi {player_id} yashuye diski ye ({player_symbol}) mu kigo {col}.

outcome.win: Umukinnyi {player_id} atsinda iyo ahurije hamwe ine!
outcome.draw: Umukino warangiye ari ubusa ku busa.
